tiles.title: MITRE ATT&CK tactics across all alerts
Entities in alerts from several products (multi-stage attacks)
Top alerted devices, IPs and URLs
Noisiest incident titles and false-positive rate
UEBA investigation priority over time (top users)
Users with highest UEBA priority and first-time behaviours
Analytics rule and connector health issues (SentinelHealth)

queries.text:
set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let SA = external_table('SecurityAlert')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend Ent = tostring(Entities)
| where isempty(_entity) or Ent has _entity or CompromisedEntity has _entity
| extend SevRank = case(AlertSeverity =~ "High", 1, AlertSeverity =~ "Medium", 2, AlertSeverity =~ "Low", 3, 4);
let XA = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PA = pack_all()
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, ServiceSource, DetectionSource, Techniques = tostring(PA.AttackTechniques);
let XE = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PE = pack_all()
| extend EntityType = tostring(PE.EntityType), EvidenceRole = tostring(PE.EvidenceRole),
         Value = coalesce(tostring(PE.AccountUpn), tostring(PE.AccountName), tostring(PE.DeviceName), tostring(PE.RemoteIP), tostring(PE.Url), tostring(PE.FileName), tostring(PE.SHA256), tostring(PE.EmailSubject), tostring(PE.Application), tostring(PE.OAuthApplicationId), tostring(PE.CloudResource))
| where isnotempty(Value)
| where isempty(_entity) or Value has _entity
| project AlertId, EntityType, EvidenceRole, Value = tolower(Value);
union
 (SA | project Product = ProductName, Severity = AlertSeverity),
 (XA | project Product = ServiceSource, Severity)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Product, Severity
| order by Alerts desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let XA = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PA = pack_all()
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, ServiceSource, DetectionSource, Techniques = tostring(PA.AttackTechniques);
let XE = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PE = pack_all()
| extend EntityType = tostring(PE.EntityType), EvidenceRole = tostring(PE.EvidenceRole),
         Value = coalesce(tostring(PE.AccountUpn), tostring(PE.AccountName), tostring(PE.DeviceName), tostring(PE.RemoteIP), tostring(PE.Url), tostring(PE.FileName), tostring(PE.SHA256), tostring(PE.EmailSubject), tostring(PE.Application), tostring(PE.OAuthApplicationId), tostring(PE.CloudResource))
| where isnotempty(Value)
| where isempty(_entity) or Value has _entity
| project AlertId, EntityType, EvidenceRole, Value = tolower(Value);
XE
| join kind=inner XA on AlertId
| summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId), Products = dcount(ServiceSource), ProductList = make_set(ServiceSource, 10), Tactics = make_set(Category, 10),
            Titles = make_set(Title, 10), High = dcountif(AlertId, Severity =~ "High"), FirstAlert = min(AlertTime), LastAlert = max(AlertTime) by EntityType, Value
| extend Severity = case(Products >= 3 or (Products >= 2 and High > 0), "1-High (cross-domain)", Products >= 2, "2-Medium (two products)", Alerts >= 5, "3-Medium (repeated)", "4-Low")
| order by Severity asc, Products desc, Alerts desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let XA = external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PA = pack_all()
| project AlertTime = TimeGenerated, AlertId, Title, Severity, Category, ServiceSource, DetectionSource, Techniques = tostring(PA.AttackTechniques);
let XE = external_table('AlertEvidence')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend PE = pack_all()
| extend EntityType = tostring(PE.EntityType), EvidenceRole = tostring(PE.EvidenceRole),
         Value = coalesce(tostring(PE.AccountUpn), tostring(PE.AccountName), tostring(PE.DeviceName), tostring(PE.RemoteIP), tostring(PE.Url), tostring(PE.FileName), tostring(PE.SHA256), tostring(PE.EmailSubject), tostring(PE.Application), tostring(PE.OAuthApplicationId), tostring(PE.CloudResource))
| where isnotempty(Value)
| where isempty(_entity) or Value has _entity
| project AlertId, EntityType, EvidenceRole, Value = tolower(Value);
let Order = dynamic(["InitialAccess","Execution","Persistence","PrivilegeEscalation","DefenseEvasion","CredentialAccess","Discovery","LateralMovement","Collection","CommandAndControl","Exfiltration","Impact"]);
XE
| where EntityType in~ ("User", "Mailbox", "Machine", "Account")
| join kind=inner XA on AlertId
| summarize Tactics = make_set(Category), Alerts = dcount(AlertId), FirstAlert = min(AlertTime), LastAlert = max(AlertTime), Titles = make_set(Title, 8) by EntityType, Value
| extend Covered = array_length(set_intersect(Tactics, Order))
| extend Severity = case(Covered >= 4, "1-Critical (4+ stages)", Covered == 3, "2-High (3 stages)", Covered == 2, "3-Medium", "4-Low")
| extend SpanHours = datetime_diff('hour', LastAlert, FirstAlert)
| project Severity, EntityType, Value, Covered, Tactics, Alerts, SpanHours, FirstAlert, LastAlert, Titles
| order by Severity asc, Covered desc, Alerts desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let SA = external_table('SecurityAlert')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend Ent = tostring(Entities)
| where isempty(_entity) or Ent has _entity or CompromisedEntity has _entity
| extend SevRank = case(AlertSeverity =~ "High", 1, AlertSeverity =~ "Medium", 2, AlertSeverity =~ "Low", 3, 4);
SA
| where isnotempty(CompromisedEntity) or isnotempty(Ent)
| mv-expand E = todynamic(Ent)
| extend Kind = tostring(E.Type), Value = tolower(coalesce(tostring(E.UserPrincipalName), strcat(tostring(E.Name), iff(isnotempty(tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), strcat("@", tostring(E.UPNSuffix)), "")), tostring(E.HostName), tostring(E.Address), tostring(E.Url), tostring(E.DomainName)))
| where isnotempty(Kind) and isnotempty(Value) and Value != "@"
| summarize Alerts = dcount(SystemAlertId), High = dcountif(SystemAlertId, AlertSeverity =~ "High"), Rules = make_set(AlertName, 5), Products = make_set(ProductName, 5), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by Kind, Value
| order by High desc, Alerts desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Inc = external_table('SecurityIncident')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 30d) .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime between (_startTime .. _endTime) or Status != "Closed"
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(todynamic(tostring(Owner)).assignedTo), tostring(todynamic(tostring(Owner)).userPrincipalName), "Unassigned")
| extend SevRank = case(Severity =~ "High", 1, Severity =~ "Medium", 2, Severity =~ "Low", 3, 4);
Inc
| where Status != "Closed"
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), CreatedTime)
| extend SLA = case(Severity =~ "High" and AgeDays >= 1, "1-Breached (High > 1 day)", Severity =~ "Medium" and AgeDays >= 3, "2-Breached (Medium > 3 days)", AgeDays >= 7, "3-Breached (> 7 days)", "4-Within SLA")
| project SLA, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, OwnerName, AgeDays, CreatedTime, ProviderName
| order by SLA asc, AgeDays desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Inc = external_table('SecurityIncident')
| where TimeGenerated between ((_startTime - 30d) .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime between (_startTime .. _endTime) or Status != "Closed"
| extend OwnerName = coalesce(tostring(todynamic(tostring(Owner)).assignedTo), tostring(todynamic(tostring(Owner)).userPrincipalName), "Unassigned")
| extend SevRank = case(Severity =~ "High", 1, Severity =~ "Medium", 2, Severity =~ "Low", 3, 4);
Inc
| summarize Incidents = count(), Closed = countif(Status == "Closed"), FalsePositive = countif(Classification == "FalsePositive"), Benign = countif(Classification == "BenignPositive"),
            TruePositive = countif(Classification == "TruePositive") by Title
| extend FPRate = round(100.0 * (FalsePositive + Benign) / max_of(Closed, long(1)), 1)
| extend Action = case(FPRate >= 80 and Closed >= 5, "1-Tune or suppress rule", TruePositive > 0, "3-Keep (true positives)", "2-Review")
| order by Action asc, Incidents desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Ueba = external_table('BehaviorAnalytics')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
| where isempty(_entity) or UserPrincipalName has _entity or SourceIPAddress has _entity;
Ueba
| where InvestigationPriority > 0
| extend AI = todynamic(tostring(ActivityInsights)), UI = todynamic(tostring(UsersInsights))
| summarize MaxPriority = max(InvestigationPriority), Events = count(), Activities = make_set(ActionType, 10),
            FirstTimeCountry = countif(tostring(AI.FirstTimeUserConnectedFromCountry) == "True"),
            FirstTimeApp = countif(tostring(AI.FirstTimeUserUsedApp) == "True" or tostring(AI.FirstTimeUserAccessedResource) == "True"),
            UncommonAmongPeers = countif(tostring(AI.CountryUncommonlyConnectedFromAmongPeers) == "True" or tostring(AI.ActionUncommonlyPerformedAmongPeers) == "True"),
            UncommonISP = countif(tostring(AI.ISPUncommonlyUsedInTenant) == "True"),
            Dormant = countif(tostring(UI.IsDormantAccount) == "True"), IPs = make_set(SourceIPAddress, 5), Locations = make_set(SourceIPLocation, 5) by UserPrincipalName
| extend Severity = case(MaxPriority >= 7, "1-High", MaxPriority >= 4, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| order by MaxPriority desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Anom = external_table('Anomalies')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_user) or UserPrincipalName =~ _user
| where isempty(_entity) or UserPrincipalName has _entity or SourceIpAddress has _entity or tostring(Entities) has _entity;
Anom
| summarize Anomalies = count(), MaxScore = max(todouble(Score)), Templates = make_set(AnomalyTemplateName, 10), Tactics = make_set(Tactics, 10),
            IPs = make_set(SourceIpAddress, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName
| where isnotempty(UserPrincipalName)
| extend Severity = case(MaxScore >= 0.8, "1-High", MaxScore >= 0.5, "2-Medium", "3-Low")
| order by MaxScore desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('SentinelHealth')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where Status !in~ ("Success")
| summarize Failures = count(), LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated), Reasons = make_set(Description, 3) by SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceName, Status
| extend Severity = case(Status =~ "Failure" and Failures >= 3, "1-High (repeated failure)", Status =~ "Failure", "2-Medium", "3-Low (warning)")
| order by Severity asc, Failures desc
| take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let SA = external_table('SecurityAlert')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend Ent = tostring(Entities)
| where isempty(_entity) or Ent has _entity or CompromisedEntity has _entity
| extend SevRank = case(AlertSeverity =~ "High", 1, AlertSeverity =~ "Medium", 2, AlertSeverity =~ "Low", 3, 4);
SA
| where ProductName has "Sentinel" or ProviderName has "ASI"
| summarize Alerts = count(), Entities = dcount(CompromisedEntity), High = countif(AlertSeverity =~ "High"), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName
| extend Noise = case(Alerts >= 100, "1-Very noisy", Alerts >= 20, "2-Noisy", "3-Normal")
| order by Alerts desc
| take 50
